name: Middle Route — Cumberland to the San Gabriel Mountains
elevationProvider: Mapzen / Tilezen Terrain Tiles, zoom 12, bilinear DEM samples
authoredConditions: Frozen post-apocalyptic weather, snow patches, surface roughness and roadside scenery. OSM road widths are retained when available; missing widths use lane counts or explicitly estimated defaults. Bridge decks approximate approach heights; DEM is not a surveyed racing surface.
structure: Eleven ordered local road stages joined geographically on the world map; travel between stages is not a playable connecting highway. Tower Hill is unchanged. Mount Washington retains its geometry and race implementation with authored snow conditions.
rebuild: python tools/campaigns/import_america.py --download # only missing OSM snapshots
elevationAttribution: Mapzen/Tilezen Terrain Tiles, accessed 2026-11-10; see per-race metadata for coverage.
roadComfort: 45 m runtime elevation smoothing; 8 m flat shoulder join, 32 m blend, 0.22 maximum cut/fill slope. New roads have collinear survey points no more than 80 m apart and DEM at every node. Finite 400 m untimed runouts are authored; timed GPS road plan is retained.

paceNotes.method: Virtual recce of road-wheel steering, integrated heading, a braking envelope and power-limited acceleration. Checks inside-apex doodads for do-not-cut hazards. Numeric severity thresholds are game-specific calibration; not proprietary WRC Generations values.

racingLine.method: Bounded minimum-curvature path optimization with vehicle and roadside-object clearance; backward braking speed envelope on actual path curvature; shared by guide and AI.

missionConditions: tools/campaigns/mission_conditions.mjs defines optional preparation recommendations and varied snow, wet, gravel, rough-road and dry-road events. Reapply with node tools/campaigns/apply_mission_conditions.mjs. No equipment entry gates; original planning durations need playtesting under the authored conditions.
